access.description:
The access level of the dashboard.
Possible values:
DASHBOARD_PRIVATE
DASHBOARD_PUBLIC

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: The display name/title of the dashboard visible to users.

instance.description: The ID of the Chronicle instance.

is_pinned.description: Whether the dashboard is pinned by the user.

location.description: The location of the Chronicle instance.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

type.description:
The type of dashboard.
Possible values:
CURATED, PRIVATE, PUBLIC, CUSTOM, MARKETPLACE

charts.description: A list of charts included in the dashboard definition.

charts.dashboard_chart.description: The resource name of the associated DashboardChart.

charts.filters_ids.description: List of dashboard filter IDs applied to this chart.

charts.chart_layout.description: The visual layout parameters of this chart within the dashboard.

charts.chart_layout.span_x.description: The number of columns the chart spans.

charts.chart_layout.span_y.description: The number of rows the chart spans.

filters.description: Global filters defined for the dashboard.

filters.chart_ids.description: The IDs of charts that this filter applies to.

filters.data_source.description:
The data source for the filter.
Possible values:
UDM, ENTITY, INGESTION_METRICS, RULE_DETECTIONS, RULESETS, GLOBAL,
IOC_MATCHES, RULES, SOAR_CASES, SOAR_PLAYBOOKS, SOAR_CASE_HISTORY,
DATA_TABLE, INVESTIGATION, INVESTIGATION_FEEDBACK

filters.display_name.description: The display name of the filter.

filters.field_path.description: The UDM field path being filtered.

filters.id.description: The unique ID of the filter.

filters.is_mandatory.description: Whether the filter is mandatory for the dashboard consumer.

filters.is_standard_time_range_filter.description: Whether the filter is a standard time range filter.

filters.is_standard_time_range_filter_en.description: Whether the standard time range filter is currently enabled.

filters.filter_operator_and_field_values.description: The specific operator and value set for the filter.

The values for the modifier. All operators should have a single
value other than 'IN' and 'BETWEEN'.

The operator to apply to the field. Possible values: ["EQUAL", "NOT_EQUAL", "IN", "GREATER_THAN", "GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO", "LESS_THAN", "LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO", "BETWEEN", "PAST", "IS_NULL", "IS_NOT_NULL", "STARTS_WITH", "ENDS_WITH", "DOES_NOT_STARTS_WITH", "DOES_NOT_ENDS_WITH", "NOT_IN", "CONTAINS", "DOES_NOT_CONTAIN"]
